title: Deadline: Noah Of The Blood Sea Manga Gets Hollywood Live-Action Film Adaptation
content: Tyrus Pictures' Michael Zelman and Hamid Mokhneche are producing. The studio is optioning the film adaptation rights from Takeshobo . In addition, Deadline reported that the original manga is getting an English release in North America. The manga is also getting a release in Taiwan.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Gets Ready to End More Manga With 3 New Titles Revealed for 2026
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is gearing up to end even more of its series (or cancel them) as three new titles have been revealed to be on their way to the magazine through the rest of the year.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix Locks Down January 2027 Release for New Anime – Watch the Trailer

title: SEGA Confirms Leak of 2.2 Million Newsletter Recipients' Email Addresses
content: SEGA reported on Monday that the email addresses of 2,196,044 customers have been leaked after an unnamed third party accessed the systems of Arara, the company whose distribution system SEGA and SEGA Fave uses for their email newsletters.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Quest Teases New RPG for iOS, Android
content: The Dragon Quest franchise announced Dragon Quest RPG: Makai-Ju to Michibikareshi Shima ( Dragon Quest RPG: The Demon World Tree and the Shepherded Island), a new game for iOS and Android devices, on Monday. Square Enix will debut the new game's announcement trailer on Tuesday at 8:00 p.m. JST (6:00 a.m. EST).
author: ANN

title: Late Tetsuya Chiba's Autobiographical Manga to End in 8th Volume
content: Chiba launched the Hinemosu Notari Nikki autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in 2018, and the seventh volume in November 2025. Chiba put the manga on hiatus on September 25, citing poor health.
author: ANN

title: Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan Manga Resumes on November 16
content: Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine announced on Monday that Satomi U 's Heisei Haizan-hei ☆ Sumire-chan manga will resume serialization in this year's 51st issue of the magazine that will ship on November 16.
author: ANN
